---
title: "Aviation Analytics"
subtitle: "Interactive operational intelligence, delay accumulation trends, and airline performance benchmarks."
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(nycflights13)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
```

### 1. Delay Accumulation Across the Operating Day

Each point below represents a commercial departure from New York City. **Hover over any point** to inspect its operating carrier, flight number, origin-destination city pair, and observed delay.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-interactive
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

set.seed(42)
sample_scatter <- flights |>
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay), !is.na(sched_dep_time)) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000) |>
  left_join(airlines, by = "carrier") |>
  mutate(
    scheduled_hour = sched_dep_time %/% 100 + (sched_dep_time %% 100) / 60,
    hover_info = paste0(
      "Flight: ", carrier, " ", flight, " (", name, ")\n",
      "Route: ", origin, " → ", dest, "\n",
      "Scheduled: ", sprintf("%02d:%02d", sched_dep_time %/% 100, sched_dep_time %% 100), "\n",
      "Departure Delay: ", ifelse(dep_delay > 0, paste0("+", dep_delay), dep_delay), " min"
    )
  )

p_scatter <- ggplot(sample_scatter, aes(x = scheduled_hour, y = dep_delay, text = hover_info)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.3, color = "#287D9B") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#263F57", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 15, color = "#C65353", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 3),
    limits = c(0, 24),
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-30, 180)) +
  labs(
    x = "Scheduled Departure Time (24h)",
    y = "Departure Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#D4E3ED", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#14283F", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#5F7387")
  )

ggplotly(p_scatter, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#14283F", font = list(family = "IBM Plex Mono", color = "#FFFFFF")),
    margin = list(t = 20, r = 20, b = 40, l = 50)
  )
```

::: {.row .g-3 .my-2}
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Morning Schedule Adherence</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">Flights departing between 05:00 and 08:30 AM tightly hug the zero baseline. Aircraft parked overnight are unencumbered by upstream network delays.</p>
</div>
:::
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Afternoon Cascading Variance</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">After 14:00, departure delay variance widens substantially. Multi-leg aircraft utilization compounds small morning hiccups into severe late-day departures.</p>
</div>
:::
:::

### 2. Departure Delay Distribution

Interactive histogram grouping 328,521 flights into 5-minute bins. **Hover over any column** to see exact departure counts. The red dashed line marks the FAA 15-minute threshold.

```{r}
#| label: fig-histogram-interactive
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

hist_df <- flights |>
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay), dep_delay >= -30, dep_delay <= 180) |>
  mutate(bin_start = floor((dep_delay + 30) / 5) * 5 - 30) |>
  count(bin_start) |>
  mutate(
    is_delayed = bin_start >= 15,
    bar_color = if_else(is_delayed, "#C65353", "#14283F"),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Delay Range: [", bin_start, " to ", bin_start + 5, " min)\n",
      "Departures: ", comma(n), " flights\n",
      "Category: ", if_else(is_delayed, "FAA Delayed (>15m)", "On-Time / Minor (≤15m)")
    )
  )

p_hist <- ggplot(hist_df, aes(x = bin_start + 2.5, y = n, fill = bar_color, text = hover_text)) +
  geom_col(width = 4.75) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 15, linetype = "dashed", color = "#C65353", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-30, 180, by = 30)) +
  labs(
    x = "Departure Delay (minutes)",
    y = "Number of Departures"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#D4E3ED", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#14283F", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#5F7387")
  )

ggplotly(p_hist, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#14283F", font = list(family = "IBM Plex Mono", color = "#FFFFFF")),
    margin = list(t = 20, r = 20, b = 40, l = 60)
  )
```

::: {.row .g-3 .my-2}
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Modal Distribution</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">The single most frequent flight outcome is departing between 0 and 5 minutes ahead of schedule, proving baseline timetable viability.</p>
</div>
:::
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Heavy Right Skew</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">Only 21.5% of flights cross the FAA 15-minute threshold, but severe delays form a persistent tail reaching several hours.</p>
</div>
:::
:::

### 3. Carrier On-Time Performance Benchmark

Average departure delay in minutes across major airlines with at least 2,000 departures from New York metropolitan airports. **Hover over any carrier bar** to view complete operational figures:

```{r}
#| label: fig-carrier-interactive
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

carrier_summary <- flights |>
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay)) |>
  left_join(airlines, by = "carrier") |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    avg_delay = round(mean(dep_delay), 1),
    ontime_pct = round(mean(dep_delay <= 15) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(total >= 2000) |>
  mutate(
    name = reorder(name, avg_delay),
    status_group = case_when(
      avg_delay <= 10 ~ "#25845D",
      avg_delay <= 15 ~ "#D69A43",
      TRUE ~ "#C65353"
    ),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Carrier: ", name, "\n",
      "Average Departure Delay: +", avg_delay, " min\n",
      "On-Time Rate: ", ontime_pct, "%\n",
      "Annual Departures: ", comma(total)
    )
  )

p_carrier <- ggplot(carrier_summary, aes(x = name, y = avg_delay, fill = status_group, text = hover_text)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Departure Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#D4E3ED", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#14283F"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggplotly(p_carrier, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#14283F", font = list(family = "IBM Plex Mono", color = "#FFFFFF")),
    margin = list(t = 20, r = 20, b = 40, l = 160)
  )
```

::: {.row .g-3 .my-2}
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Mainline Fleet Efficiency</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">US Airways (+3.8m), American (+8.6m), and Delta (+9.3m) demonstrate superior turnaround protocols and priority gate logistics.</p>
</div>
:::
::: {.col-md-6}

  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">ExpressJet (+20.0m) and AirTran (+18.7m) bear higher delay burdens due to multi-hop regional feeder structures and lower ATC priority.</p>
</div>
